name: Vicor Corporation
moat_justification: Real, court-enforced patent estate on vertical power delivery (ITC import bans issued; AI system makers signing licenses) plus design-in switching costs and a current-density lead in gen-2 VPD, but ROIC has been cyclical and mid-teens at best (roic_proxy -0.3% FY2024, 20.9% FY2025, negative in 2016-17) — never a through-cycle wide-moat compounder.
fragility_flags: STALE_FY: latest fiscal year ended 10 months ago — check TTM/quarterly OE and consider --base-oe-ps override
OE_VOLATILE: OE/share range over the last 5 yrs spans >3x — normalized base helps but the business is cyclical; widen bear weight
NI_OCF_DIVERGENCE: net income and operating cash flow differ by >40% in 2024 — find the one-off (tax deposits, impairments, WC swings) before trusting the OE base

DEBT_TAGS_BLANK: no debt tag reports for the latest fiscal year — net debt is UNKNOWN (not zero); no leverage verdict is possible from the engine, state the balance sheet from the filing in analysis.md
BASE_DIVERGENCE: latest FY OE/share 2.25 vs 3-yr median 0.63 — one of them is distorted; find out which and why
LOW_OE_YIELD: base OE yield 0.8% — valuation rests almost entirely on growth; tier is fragile
WIDE_SCENARIO_SPREAD: super-bull IV is 12.3x super-bear IV — uncertainty is huge; confidence should not be high
one_liner: Real patent moat and an AI power ramp, moat 5/10 — but at $191.50 the price is beyond even the super-bull IV@15% of $100.54; weighted IRR 5.6% on the TTM base, and it clears 15% only below $37.67.
moat_for: Patent estate with teeth: ITC import bans vs Delta/Quanta/Foxconn units; two AI-system-maker licenses in four months (incl. 2026-09-16) because indemnification cannot beat an import ban
Design-in switching costs: power delivery qualified into processor platforms is painful to re-engineer
Gen-2 VPD current-density lead (3 A/mm2 at lead customer, >4 targeted)
Gross margin expanding on mix: 50.6% FY2023 to 57.3% FY2025, 58.0% Q2 2026
moat_against: ROIC volatile and mid-teens at best through the cycle (negative FY2024 and 2016-17) — no proven through-cycle pricing power
Customer concentration: lead AI customer, hyperscaler ramps not yet in revenue
Deep-pocketed competition (MPS, Infineon, Delta, Navitas) designing around the patents
Profit mix shifting to license/settlement income that decays unless modules convert it
Capacity-constrained: Andover fab near full, second fab is execution and capex risk
